long_biography.plain_text:
Federico Bellini based his career in Ibiza's luxury-service economy and founded Belcost with Francesca Costa. He was Belcost Service Ibiza's original sole shareholder and administrator from its 2015 incorporation. He developed the business around bespoke travel planning, placing curated service and destination knowledge ahead of a high-volume catalogue model.

As chief executive, Bellini leads a team serving international clients across Mediterranean and other luxury destinations. Belcost coordinates tailored journeys, hospitality stays, private aviation, concierge support and access to local partners. Bellini's work combines founder ownership with luxury-sales management, relationship-building and detailed trip operations, giving the company a service-led identity rather than a conventional booking-platform model.
